text:
Olivia T.: quick heads-up — I opened a PR for the dashboard presets docs and a small rename of the metric keys. need a fast pass on phrasing for the cost vs latency breakdown before i merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4782 :wave:
Ben K.: on it. which snippet should we prefer — the small card widget or the full metrics table?
Leah: card widget is what product wants for the quickstart, but the examples page still has the table. we should keep both but make clear recommended for low-latency views is the card.
Jason M.: saw the PR, build failed on the link-check stage. docs-ci-bot shows 404 on one internal link.
docs-ci-bot: build failed — 1 broken link (internal). See: /console/old-metrics-presets -> 404.
Olivia T.: thanks, i'll patch the link to /console/metrics/presets and push. also suggest wording change: current copy says "cost/latency tradeoffs" — propose "cost and latency breakdown (recommended for choosing a preset)" — thoughts?
Ben K.: i like that. slightly more actionable. also add an inline note that quantized models may change token cost numbers.
Leah: agree. Can we add a tiny Python + JS snippet to show how to fetch the preset config? that'll help users copy-paste.
Jason M.: snippet idea lgtm. keep the JS async streaming example minimal.
Olivia T.: adding both. new snippets (minimal):
```python
# python — fetch preset config
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
preset = client.console.get_preset("low-latency")
print(preset)
```
```javascript
// js — show card widget sample
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const r = new Redwood({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const preset = await r.console.getPreset('low-latency')
renderCard({ title: preset.name, latency: preset.latency_ms, cost: preset.cost_per_1k })
```
Ben K.: tiny nit: js example uses await at top-level — add comment or wrap in async IIFE.
Leah: also add a short sentence under the code block about how latency numbers are medians from our benchmark pool.
Olivia T.: will do. patching link now and fixing js snippet. pushing in ~10m. if someone can eyeball the new phrasing for the breakdown and the short callout about quantized models that would be great. :pray:
Ben K.: i'll review after your push. tagging me with @ben if you want me to merge. :+1:
Jason M.: once CI passes, can we also add a redirect from the old path so other links don't break? i can throw a 301 redirect in the docs router.
Leah: that would be ideal — saves churn in other internal docs.
Olivia T.: noted. pushing fix now. cc @docs-ci-bot for re-run. :rocket:
docs-ci-bot: build queued — re-run requested by Olivia T.
Ben K.: looked through the new copy — one wording tweak: 'recommended for choosing a preset' -> 'recommended when selecting a preset for latency-sensitive workloads'. small but clearer.
Olivia T.: applied Ben's tweak. all set from my side. merging when CI green. thanks y'all! :tada:
